## Change

Describe the change and link the related issue. For a new harness, name its
maintainers and explain what the experiment explores.

## Build

For a harness change, provide the build command and result.
For documentation or shared infrastructure, describe the relevant verification.

## Manual verification

Describe any runtime verification, or state that runtime behavior was not checked.

## Checklist

- [ ] My commits include DCO sign-offs (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I followed the Code of Conduct, including its guidance on AI assistance.
- [ ] I updated the relevant documentation and, for a new harness, the catalog.
- [ ] I included no credentials or private configuration.
